name: MyMemory Translate Text
job_to_be_done: Translate a short text string into a target language using the MyMemory Translation API.
short_description: Translate text with MyMemory (defaults source_lang to en).
description: Calls the MyMemory Translation API endpoint GET /get to translate a single UTF-8 text string. Provide `target_lang` and optionally `source_lang` (defaults to en).
example_prompts: Translate this email to German with a more formal tone.
